svg.title: Cloudra architecture: hypotheses, computation and scientific evidence
svg.desc: Four equal cards occupy the upper-left, upper-right, lower-right and lower-left corners in a clockwise research cycle. Their empty inner corners overlap the four corners of the central Cloudra Agent System logo card. The modules retain scientific input and delivery DAG; geometry and pathway preparation; computational infrastructure; and mechanistic validation and refinement. The last module combines same-TS, bidirectional real IRC, endpoint optimization and frequencies with mapped chemical identities, interprets reaction-centered normal-mode motion as advisory diagnostics, and supports evidence-guided revision followed by renewed verification. Solid arrows show the research cycle; the dashed return carries guided diagnostics. Diagrams and motion-composition bars are schematic, not measured results.

svg.title: Cloudra
svg.desc: A single teal dragon, a detached curled tail, and continuous branching scientific exploration paths rising from a golden potential-energy surface. Rebuilt editable vector artwork.
